facts.clause: Sejuani charges, dealing […] magic damage to enemies and Knocking them Up
Sejuani charges forward, knocking enemies into the air.
She then lashes out again, dealing […] physical damage and briefly Slowing targets.
Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks.
Sejuani throws her bola that freezes and stuns the first champion hit and creates an ice storm that slows other enemies.
